event: A creak sound occurs when a person knocks on the front door.

sounding_object.description: The sounding object is the front door. It is a light blue, arched wooden door with a black metal handle and a small, square, four-paned window at eye level. A wreath decorated with green foliage, pink and white flowers, and some colored (Easter) eggs is hanging on the door. The door appears to be made of wood and is approximately 2 meters tall and 0.8-0.9 meters wide.

reference_object.description: A large, black, flat-screen television, likely 50-60 inches diagonally. It is placed on a light-colored wooden media console, positioned to the right of a white fireplace.

facing_object.description: A traditional wooden china cabinet, tall and rectangular. It has a medium-brown wood finish. The upper section features glass-paneled doors, through which white dishware is visible. The lower section has solid wood panels/drawers. It is approximately 2 meters tall and 1 meter wide.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the tv and facing the wooden china cabinet, when the creak sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: left, right, or back? If the object is generally to your left and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees left, choose 'left'. If the object is generally to your right and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees right, choose 'right'. If the object is generally behind you and facing it requires turning 120 degrees or more, choose 'back'.
